nodes.description: Read every video frame and emit capture timing.
nodes.name: file
nodes.pseudo_code:
cap = cv2.VideoCapture('Videos/Samplevdo.mp4'); assert cap.isOpened(); reported_fps = float(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)); fps = reported_fps if reported_fps > 0 else 25.0; index = 0
while True:
    ok, frame = cap.read()
    if not ok: break
    position_ms = float(cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC))
    timestamp_seconds = position_ms / 1000.0 if position_ms > 0 else index / fps
    capture_utc = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    meta = {'frame_index': index, 'timestamp_seconds': timestamp_seconds, 'capture_utc': capture_utc, 'fps': fps}
    emit(p01o_frame=frame, p01o_meta=meta)
    index += 1
cap.release()

nodes.description: Letterbox BGR frames and create normalized RGB tensors.
nodes.pseudo_code:
orig_h, orig_w = frame.shape[:2]
r = min(640 / orig_h, 640 / orig_w)
new_w, new_h = round(orig_w * r), round(orig_h * r)
resized = cv2.resize(frame, (new_w, new_h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
canvas = np.full((640, 640, 3), 114, dtype=np.uint8)
pad_x, pad_y = (640 - new_w) // 2, (640 - new_h) // 2
canvas[pad_y:pad_y + new_h, pad_x:pad_x + new_w] = resized
blob = cv2.cvtColor(canvas, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
blob = np.ascontiguousarray(np.transpose(blob, (2, 0, 1))[None])
geometry = {'orig_w': orig_w, 'orig_h': orig_h, 'ratio': r, 'pad_x': pad_x, 'pad_y': pad_y}
return blob, geometry

nodes.description: Run the selected YOLO11s model on each frame.
nodes.pseudo_code:
session = ort.InferenceSession('models/yolo11s.onnx', providers=ort.get_available_providers())
raw = session.run(['output0'], {'images': blob})[0]
return raw

nodes.description: Decode YOLO boxes, suppress overlaps, retain people.
nodes.pseudo_code:
preds = np.squeeze(raw, 0).T
boxes_xywh, scores = preds[:, :4], preds[:, 4:]
class_ids = np.argmax(scores, axis=1)
confidences = scores[np.arange(scores.shape[0]), class_ids]
keep = confidences >= 0.35
boxes_xywh, confidences, class_ids = boxes_xywh[keep], confidences[keep], class_ids[keep]
people = []
if len(boxes_xywh) == 0: return people
cx, cy, w, h = boxes_xywh.T
x1 = np.clip((cx - w / 2 - geometry['pad_x']) / geometry['ratio'], 0, geometry['orig_w'])
y1 = np.clip((cy - h / 2 - geometry['pad_y']) / geometry['ratio'], 0, geometry['orig_h'])
x2 = np.clip((cx + w / 2 - geometry['pad_x']) / geometry['ratio'], 0, geometry['orig_w'])
y2 = np.clip((cy + h / 2 - geometry['pad_y']) / geometry['ratio'], 0, geometry['orig_h'])
# The source takes argmax over all 80 COCO scores before filtering for person (class 0).
idxs = np.where(class_ids == 0)[0]
if len(idxs):
    rects = np.stack([x1[idxs], y1[idxs], (x2 - x1)[idxs], (y2 - y1)[idxs]], axis=1)
    selected = cv2.dnn.NMSBoxes(rects.tolist(), confidences[idxs].tolist(), 0.35, 0.45)
    selected = np.array(selected).flatten() if len(selected) else []
    for i in selected:
        oi = idxs[i]
        people.append({'box': [float(x1[oi]), float(y1[oi]), float(x2[oi]), float(y2[oi])], 'score': float(confidences[oi]), 'class': 'person'})
return people

nodes.description: Test tracked foot points and report zone entries.
nodes.name: restricted-zone entry
nodes.pseudo_code:
polygon = np.array(parameters['region_polygon_pixels'], dtype=np.float32)
result = []
# previous_zone is persistent per track ID; a newly observed ID starts outside.
for trk in tracks:
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = trk['box']
    foot = ((x1 + x2) / 2, y2)
    inside = cv2.pointPolygonTest(polygon, foot, False) >= 0
    zone = 'Restricted Area' if inside else None
    old = previous_zone.get(trk['id'])
    transition = 'entry' if old is None and zone is not None else ('exit' if old is not None and zone is None else None)
    previous_zone[trk['id']] = zone
    result.append({'track': trk, 'zone': zone, 'transition': transition})
return {'observations': result, 'polygon': parameters['region_polygon_pixels']}

nodes.description: Accumulate observed in-zone frames for each visit.
nodes.name: restricted-zone dwell time
nodes.pseudo_code:
# Persistent records are keyed by track ID. FPS converts observed frames to seconds, as in the source.
# Keep a separate visit counter so the requested entry-to-exit dwell resets on exit.
observations = []
for item in zone_data['observations']:
    trk, zone, transition = item['track'], item['zone'], item['transition']
    tid = trk['id']
    if tid not in records:
        records[tid] = {'frames_in_zone': 0, 'visit_frames': 0, 'streak': 0, 'peak_streak': 0, 'last_zone_name': None, 'visit_number': 0}
    rec = records[tid]
    if transition == 'entry':
        rec['visit_frames'] = 0
        rec['visit_number'] += 1
    if zone is not None:
        rec['frames_in_zone'] += 1
        rec['visit_frames'] += 1
        rec['streak'] += 1
        rec['last_zone_name'] = zone
    else:
        rec['streak'] = 0
    rec['peak_streak'] = max(rec['peak_streak'], rec['streak'])
    visit_dwell = rec['visit_frames'] / source_meta['fps']
    observations.append({'track': trk, 'zone': zone, 'transition': transition, 'visit_number': rec['visit_number'], 'dwell_time_seconds': visit_dwell, 'cumulative_zone_seconds': rec['frames_in_zone'] / source_meta['fps']})
    if transition == 'exit': rec['visit_frames'] = 0
return {'observations': observations, 'polygon': zone_data['polygon']}

nodes.description: Raise one incident when visit dwell reaches threshold.
nodes.name: dwell-time incident alert
outputs: incident events and current alert status

parameters.method: Compare restricted-zone dwell time with the configured…

nodes.pseudo_code:
events = []
annotated = []
threshold = parameters['dwell_alert_threshold_seconds']
# alerted_visits persists for the input stream and prevents repeated incidents per visit.
for item in dwell_data['observations']:
    tid = item['track']['id']
    key = (tid, item['visit_number'])
    active = item['zone'] is not None and item['dwell_time_seconds'] >= threshold
    if active and key not in alerted_visits:
        alerted_visits.add(key)
        events.append({'track_id': tid, 'zone': item['zone'], 'dwell_time_seconds': item['dwell_time_seconds'], 'visit_number': item['visit_number']})
    annotated.append({**item, 'alert_active': active})
return {'observations': annotated, 'polygon': dwell_data['polygon'], 'events': events}

nodes.description: Display original-sized frames with boxes and incidents.
nodes.name: display
nodes.pseudo_code:
out = frame.copy()
h, w = out.shape[:2]
scale = w / 1400
box_thick = max(2, int(3 * scale))
label_scale = max(0.8, 1.1 * scale)
label_thick = max(1, int(2 * scale))
cv2.polylines(out, [np.array(context['polygon'], dtype=np.int32)], True, (0, 0, 255), max(2, int(4 * scale)))
for item in context['observations']:
    trk = item['track']
    color = (0, 0, 255) if item['alert_active'] else ((0, 140, 255) if item['zone'] else (0, 200, 0))
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, trk['box'])
    cv2.rectangle(out, (x1, y1), (x2, y2), color, box_thick)
    status = f"INTRUSION! {item['dwell_time_seconds']:.1f}s" if item['alert_active'] else (f"IN ZONE {item['dwell_time_seconds']:.1f}s" if item['zone'] else 'CLEAR')
    label = f"ID {trk['id']} {status}"
    (tw, th), baseline = cv2.getTextSize(label, cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, label_scale, label_thick)
    label_y = max(th + baseline + 8, y1)
    cv2.rectangle(out, (x1, label_y-th-baseline-8), (x1+tw+12, label_y), color, -1)
    cv2.putText(out, label, (x1+6, label_y-baseline-3), cv2.FONT_HERSHEY_SIMPLEX, label_scale, (0, 0, 0), label_thick, cv2.LINE_AA)
cv2.imshow('Restricted-zone intrusion', out)
cv2.waitKey(1)

nodes.description: Write actual timestamped incidents into one JSON file.
nodes.name: json
nodes.pseudo_code:
path = 'output/metadata.json'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
# Open once, before the first frame; an empty run remains a valid empty array.
f = open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8'); f.write('['); first_record = True
for record in context['incident_records']:
    if not first_record: f.write(',\n')
    json.dump(record, f, ensure_ascii=False)
    first_record = False
f.flush()
# On end of stream: f.write(']\n'); f.close().
